bio: I’m Mohamed Ali Chouikh — Daly for short. A software and AI engineer based in Monastir, Tunisia.

I build across the stack: interfaces people use, backend systems they rely on, and AI tools that connect the two. Alongside my master’s in software engineering, I’ve delivered freelance projects and worked with engineering teams in Sousse.
